# Eukairox

## About
Eukairox leases managed AI employees to Ontario service businesses. AI employees answer calls, book appointments and jobs, dispatch and schedule, follow up, request reviews, and handle reporting and admin. Every AI employee is trained on the client's business and supervised by humans at Eukairox. Restaurants are the flagship proof vertical; dental clinics and trades/home services are the current expansion focus.

## AI Employee Roles
- AI Receptionist: answers calls, books/intake, transfers urgent items, transcripts and summaries
- AI Scheduler & Dispatcher: bookings, job scheduling, reminders, reschedules, replacements
- AI Follow-Up & Reviews: quote/chase follow-up, no-show recovery, review requests, reactivation
- AI Billing & Reporting: invoice nudges, daily operations summary, KPI alerts
- AI Admin & Compliance: forms, logs, checklists, renewals, training records
- AI Operations Coordinator: stock, job status, supplier and recurring-task follow-up

## Pricing
- AI Receptionist: $499/month (one role)
- AI Front Office: $1,299/month (receptionist + scheduler/dispatcher + follow-up)
- AI Operations Team: $2,900/month (full team, dedicated supervisor)
- Multi-location / multi-branch: custom
- Pilot: 14-day paid pilot, $499, credited to the first month. Success metric agreed before launch.
- Guarantee: 3x ROI in 90 days or Eukairox works free until it is reached. Cancel with 30 days notice.

## Industries
- Flagship proof: Restaurants & Hospitality
- Expansion focus: Dental & Clinics; Trades & Home Services
- Also served via fit call: law firms, real estate, professional services, e-commerce, recruitment

## How It Works
1. 15-minute fit call: map one workflow and agree the success metric.
2. Train: AI trained on services, prices, calendar/tools, scripts, and rules. Single role can target 48 hours.
3. Pilot: 14-day paid pilot, credited to month one.
4. Supervise: dashboard, call transcripts, weekly numbers, human escalation and tuning by Eukairox.
